```{r}
df <- read.csv('/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1-backup/00.protein-seq-evo-v0/02.intermediates/04.kras/ddg_vep.csv', sep = ',')

df_ddg <- merge(df, anno_subset, by.x="Pos_real", by.y="Pos")

df_ddg
```

```{r}
test_ddg <- fread("/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/decay_pdb/KRAS/AF-P01116-F1-model_v4.csv")

colnames(test_esm)[2] <- "ESM1v"
  
test_ddg[, new_position := pos + 1]
test_ddg[, variant := paste0(wtAA, new_position, mutAA)]
test_ddg <- test_ddg %>% dplyr::rename(ddG_pred = `ddG (kcal/mol)`)
```

```{r}
test_merged_df <- merge(df_ddg, test_df, by.x="id", by.y="variant")
nrow(test_merged_df) 
test_merged_df
```
```{r}
allo <- c(10,15,16,17,18,20,28,31,32,34,35,37,54,55,
          57,58,59,60,63,68,69,71,72,75,76,78,83,110,112,117,156)

ortho <- c(21 ,25 ,31, 33 ,36, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41, 67 ,71,3, 21, 24, 25, 29, 33 ,36, 37, 38, 39, 40 ,41, 63, 64, 70 ,73,24 ,25 ,31, 33, 36, 37, 38 ,39 ,40, 41, 56, 64, 67,1,  21,  22, 24 , 25,  26 , 27, 33,  36 , 38 ,39,  40,  41,  42,  43,  44,  45 , 50,  52 ,  56, 64, 65,  66 , 67,  70,  73 , 95 ,102, 103, 105, 149 ,153,
            12,  13,  14,  15 , 16,  17 , 18 , 19 , 28  ,29,  30,  32,  34,  35 , 57  ,60 , 61, 116, 117, 119, 120, 145 ,146 ,147 #GXP interface
           )

fil_test_merged_df <- test_merged_df %>%
  filter(!Pos_real %in% ortho)

# Fit a loess model using the filtered data
loess_fit_comp <- loess(ESM1v ~ ddG_pred, data = fil_test_merged_df, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")

# Predict fitted values for ALL data points using the loess model trained on fil_gck_df
test_merged_df$fitted_comp <- predict(loess_fit_comp, newdata = test_merged_df)

# Calculate residuals for ALL points
test_merged_df$residuals_comp <- test_merged_df$ESM1v - test_merged_df$fitted_comp
sum(is.na(test_merged_df$residuals_comp)) #0
head(test_merged_df)
```
```{r}
core_pos <- unique (df_ddg %>% filter (abundance_ddg >= 1) %>% pull(Pos_real))
core_pos
```


```{r}
test_merged_df
test_residue <- test_merged_df %>%
  group_by(Pos_real) %>%
  summarise(resid_median_esm1v = median(residuals_comp, na.rm = TRUE),
            # resid_median_esm2  = median(resid_esm2,  na.rm = TRUE),
            ddgb_median        = median(raf1_ddg,  na.rm = TRUE),
            esm1v_median       = median(ESM1v,       na.rm = TRUE),
            # esm2_median        = median(esm2,        na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(site_type = case_when(Pos_real %in% ortho ~ "Binding site",
                               Pos_real %in% allo ~ "Allosteric site",
                               Pos_real %in% core_pos ~ "Core site",
                               TRUE                        ~ "Non-orthosteric site"))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
site_cols <- c(
"Non-orthosteric site" = "darkgreen",
"Allosteric site"      = "cyan",
"Binding site"         = "orange",
"Core site" = "red"
)
nrow(test_residue)
cor.test(test_residue$esm1v_median, test_residue$ddgb_median, method="spearman") #-0.31
cor.test(test_residue$resid_median_esm1v, test_residue$ddgb_median, method="spearman") #-0.21

p6 <- ggplot(test_residue, aes(x = ddgb_median , y = esm1v_median, color = site_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "KRAS",
    subtitle = "Spearman's rho = -0.31",
    x = "Experimental median ddGb",
    y = "Median ESM1v",
    color = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Non-orthosteric site" = "darkgreen",
    "Allosteric site" = "cyan",
    "Binding site" = "orange",
    "Core site" = "red"
  )) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") 


p8 <- ggplot(test_residue, aes(x = ddgb_median , y = resid_median_esm1v, color = site_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    subtitle = "Spearman's rho = -0.21",
    x = "Experimental median ddGb",
    y = "Median ESM1v-ddGf residual",
    color = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Non-orthosteric site" = "darkgreen",
    "Allosteric site" = "cyan",
    "Binding site" = "orange",
    "Core site" = "red"
  )) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") 

plot_grid(p6,p8,ncol=2)
```
